continuation.text:
I removed one restriction from `is_allocation_feasible` in `src/solution.py`. I didn't run it or write any checks.

The old version returned `False` when every resource was used up exactly, because it required something to be left over. The requirements only ask whether the requests fit within capacity, so I dropped that rule. Exact-fit allocations now return `True`. I also updated the docstring to match.

The rest of the function is as it was:
- It returns `False` when a request names an unknown resource.
- It returns `False` when total demand for a resource exceeds its capacity.
- It raises `ValueError` if a request isn't a dict. I kept this because removing it wasn't needed.
